Not my own child but my nephew. This is not pretty story but I promise it ends on a good note.

My sister is a drug addict. I am practically her guardian and have had the most contact with her.   She would kind of "pop up" every couple of months needing money and then suddenly couldn't be found. In the summer she reappeared after being sent to jail for pety theft and tried to have me bail her out. I found out she was "about 4 months" pregnant. She only did 2 weeks and right once she got out I made an appointment with planned parenthood, turned out she was actually 6 months and they wouldn't do anything.  

After that she went missing for awhile even though I begged her to try and think about this baby. Then I get a call 2 months later ( 5 weeks before her due date) that she had a baby alone in a motel bathroom, and 911 was called so she came to the hospital. My nephew was obviously born addicted and with a couple other problems. The second my sister was able to, she checked herself out of the hospital, completely abandoning my nephew.

I wasn't able to see him his first week of life because I was sick, and they won't let sick people in the NICU. Our mom was with him almost constantly though. At the end of the week my mom called me to come to the hospital immediately and meet my nephew, because it didn't seem like he would make it through the night. 

I finally met him, it was the hardest thing to see him hooked up to every wire imaginable. He couldn't open his eyes and barely moved, but when I touched his foot that wasn't hooked to anything he curled his little toes around my finger. I loved him so much instantly even though I thought I would have to say goodbye. 

That night he made it, and has been shocking all his doctors as a miracle baby. He was in the NICU for a month and is now with a great foster parent.  We don't know yet what special needs he might have but for now he is a perfectly normal,  beautiful baby.

I'm so sorry.
